versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
controles.livre: Farás também um altar para queimar incenso: de madeira de acácia o farás.

versos.hebraico: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Its length shall be a cubit, and its breadth a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
controles.kjv: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
controles.livre: Seu comprimento será de um côvado, e sua largura de um côvado: será quadrado: e sua altura de dois côvados: e suas pontas serão do mesmo.

versos.hebraico: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
controles.livre: E o cobrirás de ouro puro, sua parte superior, e suas paredes em derredor, e suas pontas: e lhe farás em derredor uma coroa de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ׀ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
controles.kjv: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
controles.livre: Tu lhe farás também dois anéis de ouro debaixo de sua coroa a seus dois cantos em ambos lados seus, para meter as varas com que será levado.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
controles.livre: E farás as varas de madeira de acácia, e os cobrirás de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
controles.livre: E o porás diante do véu que está junto à arca do testemunho, diante do propiciatório que está sobre o testemunho, onde eu te testificarei de mim.

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיב֛וֹ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
controles.kjv: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
controles.livre: E queimará sobre ele Arão incenso de aroma cada manhã quando preparar as lâmpadas o queimará.

versos.hebraico: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.
controles.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
controles.livre: E quando Arão acender as lâmpadas ao anoitecer, queimará o incenso: rito perpétuo diante do SENHOR por vossas idades.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
controles.kjv: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
controles.livre: Não oferecereis sobre ele incenso estrangeiro, nem holocausto, nem presente; nem tampouco derramareis sobre ele libação.

versos.hebraico: וְכִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־קַרְנֹתָ֔יו אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E sobre suas pontas fará Arão expiação uma vez no ano com o sangue da expiação para as reconciliações: uma vez no ano fará expiação sobre ele em vossas idades: será muito santo ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת־רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם֒ וְנָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה בִּפְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה בָהֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are numbered among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh, when you number them; that there be no plague among them when you number them.
controles.kjv: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the Lord, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
controles.livre: Quando tomares o número dos filhos de Israel conforme a conta deles, cada um dará ao SENHOR o resgate de sua pessoa, quando os contares, e não haverá neles mortandade por havê-los contado.

versos.hebraico: זֶ֣ה׀ יִתְּנ֗וּ כָּל־הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary; (the shekel is twenty gerahs;) half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the Lord.
controles.livre: Isto dará qualquer um que passar pela contagem, meio siclo conforme o siclo do santuário. O siclo é de vinte óbolos: a metade de um siclo será a oferta ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֗ל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Everyone who passes over to those who are numbered, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que passar pela contagem, de vinte anos acima, dará a oferta ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: הֶֽעָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא־יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְהַדַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית הַשָּׁ֑קֶל לָתֵת֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.
controles.kjv: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.
controles.livre: Nem o rico aumentará, nem o pobre diminuirá de meio siclo, quando derem a oferta ao SENHOR para fazer expiação por vossas pessoas.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת־כֶּ֣סֶף הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ עַל־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.
controles.livre: E tomarás dos filhos de Israel o dinheiro das expiações, e o darás para a obra do tabernáculo do testemunho: e será por memória aos filhos de Israel diante do SENHOR, para expiar vossas pessoas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיּ֥וֹר נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְכַנּ֥וֹ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְרָחְצָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ בֵּֽין־אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּה מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “You shall also make a basin of brass, and its base of brass, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
controles.livre: Farás também uma pia de bronze, com sua base de bronze, para lavar; e a porás entre o tabernáculo do testemunho e o altar; e porás nela água.

versos.hebraico: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
controles.kjv: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
controles.livre: E dela se lavarão Arão e seus filhos suas mãos e seus pés:

versos.hebraico: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ־מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֔ת לְהַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the Lord:
controles.livre: Quando entrarem no tabernáculo do testemunho, se hão de lavar com água, e não morrerão: e quando se achegarem ao altar para ministrar, para acender ao SENHOR a oferta que se há de consumir ao fogo,

versos.hebraico: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵיהֶ֥ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם חָק־עוֹלָ֛ם ל֥וֹ וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃פ

controles.web: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die: and it shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
controles.kjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
controles.livre: Também se lavarão as mãos e os pés, e não morrerão. E o terão por estatuto perpétuo ele e sua semente por suas gerações.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: Moreover the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר־דְּרוֹר֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְקִנְּמָן־בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִית֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וּקְנֵה־בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
controles.kjv: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
controles.livre: E tu tomarás das principais especiarias; de mirra excelente quinhentos siclos, e de canela aromática a metade, isto é, duzentos e cinquenta, e de cálamo aromático duzentos e cinquenta,

versos.hebraico: וְקִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְשֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין׃

controles.web: and of cassia five hundred, after the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
controles.kjv: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
controles.livre: E de cássia quinhentos, ao peso do santuário, e de azeite de olivas um him:

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹת֗וֹ שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: You shall make it a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
controles.livre: E farás disso o azeite da santa unção, superior unguento, obra de perfumista, o qual será o azeite da unção sagrada.

versos.hebraico: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ ב֖וֹ אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָעֵדֻֽת׃

controles.web: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the testimony,
controles.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
controles.livre: Com ele ungirás o tabernáculo do testemunho, e a arca do testemunho,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

controles.web: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
controles.kjv: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
controles.livre: E a mesa, e todos os seus utensílios, e o candelabro, e todos os seus utensílios, e o altar do incenso,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.
controles.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
controles.livre: E o altar do holocausto, todos os seus utensílios, e a pia e sua base.

versos.hebraico: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֑ים כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃

controles.web: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
controles.livre: Assim os consagrarás, e serão coisas santíssimas: tudo o que tocar neles, será santificado.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

controles.web: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
controles.livre: Ungirás também a Arão e a seus filhos, e os consagrarás para que sejam meus sacerdotes.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖י לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
controles.livre: E falarás aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Este será meu azeite da santa unção por vossas idades.

versos.hebraico: עַל־בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֨תְכֻּנְתּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, neither shall you make any like it, according to its composition: it is holy. It shall be holy to you.
controles.kjv: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
controles.livre: Sobre carne de homem não será untado, nem fareis outro semelhante, conforme sua composição: santo é; por santo haveis de tê-lo vós.

versos.hebraico: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַל־זָ֑ר וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ס

controles.web: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”
controles.kjv: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que compuser unguento semelhante, e que puser dele sobre estranho, será cortado de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח־לְךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף׀ וּשְׁחֵ֨לֶת֙ וְחֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּלְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּבַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, and onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure frankincense: there shall be an equal weight of each;
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
controles.livre: Disse ainda o SENHOR a Moisés: Toma para ti aromas, resina de estoraque e um material odorífero e gálbano aromático e incenso limpo; de tudo em igual peso:

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָהּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רוֹקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָה֥וֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: and you shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy:
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
controles.livre: E farás disso uma mistura aromática de obra de perfumista, bem misturada, pura e santa:

versos.hebraico: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּנָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְנָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נָּה לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדֻת֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: and you shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
controles.livre: E moerás alguma dela pulverizando-a, e a porás diante do testemunho no tabernáculo do testemunho, onde eu te testificarei de mim. Isso vos será coisa santíssima.

versos.hebraico: וְהַקְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּמַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The incense which you shall make, according to its composition you shall not make for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the Lord.
controles.livre: Como a mistura que farás, não vos fareis outra segundo sua composição: te será coisa sagrada para o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹהָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ס

controles.web: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
controles.kjv: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que fizer outra como ela para cheirá-la, será cortado de seus povos.
